record.title: Decide whether the changed host baseline supports a fresh diagnostic
record.intent: Reconcile host-state drift before admitting another bounded physical observation.
requirements: Review exact current host evidence and independent findings against the closed diagnostic and original isolation guarantees. GO needs disabled forwarding and no scope-facing sharing, bridge, NAT or external-routing path; an enabled filter must never be disabled to obtain progress.

If GO and deadline reserve supports execution, draft one fresh preparation-acquisition-decision batch for the unchanged one-record stopped waveform question. Reconcile any specific host predicate explicitly with no security-policy mutation, no outcome-driven waiver and no unreviewed physical controller. Plan, inspect, expected-revision admission and commit/push before execution. The completed182200 root is immutable and must never rerun.

If uncertain or failed, record the exact external prerequisite and stop physical contact. Missing RF samples still provide no verification or disproof. Do not admit a matched comparison until actual coherent RAW evidence supports its common range.

Preserve stock originals and protected material, unchanged cables and controls, no new reset/root restart/native transition for the diagnostic, and the hard deadline2026-10-03T01:38:03Z. Owned cleanup and final state must remain explicit.
acceptance: An evidence-bound GO with a separately admitted successor or an explicit external limitation is preserved.
